scenario.topic: Choose a birthday gift for a friend who likes practical things but already owns a lot
scenario.opening_question: How should we balance usefulness, uniqueness, and budget for a practical gift?

options.name: High-Quality Stainless Steel Multi-Tool
options.upside: Highly practical with many built-in functions for everyday use
options.tradeoff: May duplicate tools friend already owns and prefers separate items

options.name: Gift Card to Local Hardware Store
